copy.tagline: 生成财务报告，包含KPI、损益表和展望
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期制作公司财务报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate financial reports with KPIs, P&L, and outlook
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create regular financial reports for your company

howto.what: Claude 会生成一份季度财报页面，包含公司名称、季度标题、4个关键KPI、收入与烧钱趋势图、损益表、5条重点摘要、展望段落以及方法论折叠区。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一份季度财务报告或财报页面时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份Q3的季度财报。
say.note: Claude 会输出完整的财报页面。

say.text: 做一份包含收入图和损益表的财务报告。
say.note: Claude 会生成带图表和表格的报告。

howto.what_en: Claude generates a quarterly finance report page with company name, quarter title, 4 hero KPIs, revenue and burn charts, P&L table, 5 bullet highlights, outlook section, and collapsible methodology.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a quarterly financial report or finance report page.

say_en.text: Generate a Q3 quarterly finance report.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a complete report page.

say_en.text: Create a financial report with revenue chart and P&L table.
say_en.note: Claude generates a report with charts and tables.
